posts.materialUpdate: Aldar's 18 September official press release independently verifies AED 7.9m starting price, superseding the broker-reported AED 8.5m figure, and confirms that sales open on 26 September 2026.
posts.body:
YAS RIVA RESERVE — SALES OPEN TODAY
Aldar | Northeast Yas Island, Abu Dhabi

Aldar confirms that sales open on 26 September 2026. The gated collection has 292 four- to six-bedroom villas, including 45 homes along the waterway.

Official starting price: AED 7.9 million. This replaces the earlier preliminary AED 8.5 million figure quoted in our first update. Payment plan, EOI amount and handover have not been confirmed in the official release reviewed.

Why it matters: the verified entry price and today's sales opening give buyers a clear basis for assessing this limited Yas Island release.
